readme.run: Characterise vessel diameter, branching and tortuosity from a 3D binary mask
notes: Give a 3D binary NIfTI vessel mask (such as the segmentation output from VesselBoost)
and a new or empty output directory.
Optionally pass --brain-mask BRAIN.nii.gz on the same grid to compute ROI vessel
volume fraction, length density and junction density.
No network connection is required. Input is NIfTI only.
VesselCharter is research software. Review resolution-limited flags on thin vessels
whose diameter is under twice the largest voxel spacing.
